body: The B0R hard dependency is removed because the owner policy prerequisite is now directly and durably satisfied; policy-doc reducer repair remains separate. Finish the distinct-commit policy handoff, release only your six policy-path reservations/claim safely, then claim B0R and reserve exactly its six docs/data/sherlock paths. Proceed with hashes/metadata/transforms/aliases/timebase only; do not copy raw video and do not include participant prose in the manifests. User authority means no REB/BBC/consent hold on the underlying non-video data. Post exact source counts, replay/digest checks, and independent-review requests.
